dedupe_keys.name: azerbaijan population census 2019 volume b households by housing and living conditions and floor space by economic region and district

description: The State Statistical Committee of Azerbaijan publishes the results of the 2019 Population Census as two bilingual volumes, each a PDF inside a ZIP, on its statistical yearbooks page. Volume B, of 584 pages, holds the household tables: the number and size of households, households by type of residence and by residence affiliation, and a table of households by the housing and living conditions of the residence for every economic region and administrative-territorial unit, followed by tables of households by total and room floor space, including private houses. Volume A covers the population. Format and access: free ZIP downloads of PDFs with Azerbaijani and English headings; other population tables are XLS on the population statistics page. Licence: not stated on the pages read. Caveats: the table pages of the PDF have no extractable text layer, so figures must be read by eye or with OCR; and the exact items of the housing and living conditions table (such as water, gas or heating) could not be read for that reason. Simulation uses: district housing conditions and floor space for exposure and service planning. Related records: IPUMS International and the WorldPop population grid.
